narration.text: Every Medicare denial billed to the patient only where a valid ABN was signed, and refunded where it was not. This is a chore for the billing manager of a two-physician internal medicine practice that bills Original Medicare and has every Medicare patient sign notices for lab tests that may not be covered. Athena works it across 4 portals: Chartmend PM, Relaywave, Chartleaf EHR and Carenook. On the bench, she found 7 of 7 eligible items, worth 539 dollars of the 539 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 11 traps, and she walked past 11. Among them: An ABN whose only reason is that Medicare may not pay. An ABN signed the day after the blood draw. She took 3 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 50 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
